note: Tasks reuse cases the retrieval golden set (llm-wiki/evals/retrieval_cases.jsonl) already vouches for, so each has a known reference answer in the vault. Assertions are drafts until the first with/without run has been read; drop any that pass in both configurations.
contract: K1 an answer from the wiki carries, per claim it relies on, the claim key or id, its probability, and its status — never a bare paraphrase
K2 a superseded, disputed, or stale claim the answer touches is flagged as such in the answer, and the current claim is named beside it
K3 a question the wiki does not hold is answered as not held, with no fabricated claim and no answer from general knowledge presented as the wiki's
K4 retrieval goes through the llm-wiki-librarian subagent; the skill reads the pages the slice names before citing them and never edits anything under llm-wiki/
